history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that indicator 2, on the overall perceptions of those Member States engaged by the Peacebuilding Commission, is included in its current performance management tools to ensure that the achievement thereof is duly captured and reported.
history.administration_response: Following the Board’s recommendation, the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs began to include this indicator in the compact of the Assistant Secretary- General for Peacebuilding Support. The compact of the Assistant Secretary-General, Oscar Fernandez-Taranco, for 2021 was shared with the Board on 6 April. On the first page of the compact, the Department included an indicator on positive feedback about the support of the Peacebuilding Support Office in the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs support for the implementation of the mandate of the Peacebuilding Commission, collected through survey results and interviews with representatives of Member States and other stakeholders engaged with the Peacebuilding Commission. While the language may at first seem different, this indicator captures the same information, namely, the perception of Member States. The indicator in the compact simply provides more information on what the perception of Member States pertains to and how it will be collected. As the Department has implemented this Board recommendation, its closure is requested.
history.board_assessment: Given that a similar indicator was included in the compact of the Assistant Secretary- General for Peacebuilding Support, the Board consider this recommendation implemented.
